BrainiLab Academy · Numbers & logic

Maths from zero: little numbers, big ideas

Count, build tens, add, take away and share. Six hands-on lessons introduce arithmetic at your own pace.

By Biel Sardà · Published 30 Sept 2026 · Suggest a correction

6 short reads · A quick quiz after each one

A little curiosity goes a long way.

Start with a handful of buttons. Count them, bundle ten together, then use those small discoveries to add, subtract, multiply and share.

There is no clock to beat. Each lesson adds one idea and an activity you can change yourself. If an idea already feels familiar, jump to the next chapter.

A few words worth knowing

Add
Put amounts together to find a total.
Subtract
Find what remains when an amount is taken away.
Equal groups
Groups that each contain the same amount.
Zero
The number we use for none.
